skill1: Ability: Find and capture ghosts possessing the enemy.

caveats: ⚑ BLOCK ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING in `burst`: the ghosts≤12 branch MUST precede the ghosts=13 branch. resourceGate reads the live pool, so if the 13-branch ran first it would spend 9 (13→4) and the ≤12 branch would then ALSO fire — double burst. Do not reorder.

⚑ The ghost counter is mapped to the `teamAmmo` trigger (total ally AMMO CONSUMED crossing 100), not literal landed hits. Shots ≠ hits for SG pellets / misses, so ghost accrual is an upper bound on teams with shotguns or low hit rate.

⚑ The 1+ / 4+ threshold buffs are re-applied on a 1s interval with a 2s duration + maxStacks 1 (never a gap, never stacks) because a `passive` trigger evaluates its resourceGate once and could never turn ON as ghosts accrue, nor OFF when the burst spends them. This is an engine-idiom encoding of "continuously", not a kit-stated cadence.

⚑ "Maintains at least 1 ghost" is NOT expressible: the resource clamps at min 0, so a burst cast with 1–6 ghosts leaves 0 instead of 1. Only matters for the 1+ ATK threshold in the window right after an early burst.

⚑ The skill2 max-capacity nuke gate (min:13) reads the POST-add pool, because the skill1 +1 block dispatches first. The capture that takes 12→13 will therefore fire one 1100% proc that the kit text ("captured WHILE AT maximum capacity") does not grant — a one-per-battle over-credit.
⚑ Both the burst hits and the 1100% AoE are authored crit:true (RIDERCRIT: riders crit at the caster's sheet rate) and core-less (no "core strike" wording). Neither is measured.
⚑ `noFb` is deliberately unset everywhere (default OFF, measured-only). Burst-cast damage is FB-exempt by TIMING, not by flag.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Elegg: Boom and Shock is a team-hit-count currency unit: 100 cumulative ally hits = 1 ghost (cap 13), modeled as a `ghost` resource driven by the `teamAmmo` trigger. Ghosts gate two continuous Water-ally auras (≥1: casterAtkPct 16.2; ≥4: elemAdvantageDamagePct 35) and switch the burst between a 6×800% branch (spend 6) and a 13×800% branch (spend 9). At cap, every further capture fires a 1100% AoE (skill2). The whole damage profile is therefore a function of TEAM fire rate, not Elegg's own — validate the ghost trajectory (time to 4, time to 13, nuke count per fight) before touching any magnitude.

flags.reasoning: The kit counts LANDED HITS cumulative across all allies; the schema's only team-wide counter is `teamAmmo` (total ally ammo CONSUMED). Shots != hits: SG pellets, misses, and infinite-ammo windows all diverge, and MG hitsPerShot expands rounds. This is the single highest-leverage ⚑ on the unit — every ghost-gated effect (both auras, the burst branch, the 1100% nuke cadence) is downstream of it.
flags.recipe: Record a graded fight and count Elegg ghost-icon increments off the HUD; compare to the sim's teamAmmo crossings over the same window. If the sim over-accrues, apply a hit-rate haircut to the effective count (raise the threshold above 100) rather than fudging any magnitude.

flags.estimate: 13 ghosts = 1300 team hits; on a 5-unit comp expect the 4-ghost tier (400 hits) early-mid fight and cap reached at most once or twice, with 0-3 max-capacity nukes per fight
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #4 (stack/currency steady-state). Start + consume + rebuild ARE kit-stated (0 start, -6/-9 per burst, +1 per 100 hits), so the trajectory is DERIVABLE from the engine rather than guessed — but the derivation is only as good as the hit-count proxy above, and the burst spend makes it a sawtooth that repeatedly crosses the 4-ghost threshold.
flags.recipe: Instrument via cfg.onEvent + a resource read at each burstCast; assert the ghost count at each burst in a vitest pin. Cross-check against footage: the burst that fires 13 sequential hits instead of 6 is unmistakable in popup count.

flags.reasoning: Kit says 'continuously', which is a passive — but a `passive` trigger fires once at setup, so its resourceGate would latch at ghosts=0 and the aura would never turn on (or never turn off after a burst spend). The interval-refresh idiom is the only schema-expressible way to make a threshold-gated continuous buff track a live pool. Not a kit-stated cadence.
flags.recipe: If the engine re-evaluates resourceGate on passive blocks per-frame, collapse both blocks to {kind:'passive'} with no durationSec — verify by asserting a buffApply for casterAtkPct exists at a frame where ghosts>=1 and is absent immediately after a burst drops the pool below 1.

flags.reasoning: No per-effect floor primitive exists, and the resource declaration cannot carry min:1 while starting at 0. Error is bounded at exactly 1 ghost, and only bites the 1+ ATK aura in the window after a burst cast with fewer than 7 ghosts.
flags.recipe: If it proves to matter, add a compensating resource +1 block gated resourceGate {ghost,max:0} on a short interval, or extend the schema with a per-effect floor. Measure first: check whether any graded-comp burst actually lands with <7 ghosts.

flags.reasoning: 'captured WHILE AT maximum capacity' means the gate should read the PRE-add pool, but skill1's +1 dispatches before skill2's block, so the 12->13 capture satisfies min:13. Cross-slot ordering cannot express pre-add.
flags.recipe: Count 1100% popups in footage from the moment the ghost HUD hits 13; if the sim shows exactly one extra, raise the gate to a sentinel (e.g. track a separate 'atCap' resource set on the following tick).

flags.reasoning: 'Attacks sequentially for N time(s)' is the literal sequential-attack phrasing, so the hits should be eligible for Sequential Attack Damage buffs (sequentialDamagePct / sequentialMultPct). Risk: if the engine reserves that flavor for a narrower mechanic, this over-credits on teams carrying a sequential buffer (e.g. snow-white-heavy-arms).
flags.recipe: Run the comp with and without a sequential-damage buffer and confirm Elegg's burst bucket moves by the buffer's magnitude; if the game shows no interaction, drop the flavor.

flags.reasoning: RIDERCRIT convention — riders crit at the caster's rate. Unmeasured for this unit. No core: the text never says 'core strike', so no core:true anywhere.
flags.recipe: Read popup colour on the burst hits and on the 1100% AoE (orange + icon = crit, red CORE HIT = core). If all bodies are white, set crit:false.

flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #1: rate_of_fire and reloadFrames are known-unreliable datamine fields, and the nominal rate must be frame-quantized (effective = 60/ceil(60/nominal)). For an MG this also feeds the team hit counter that drives every ghost effect, so cadence error compounds into ghost accrual.
flags.recipe: Ammo-counter read off footage: count rounds/sec directly (the instrument that measures the disputed quantity), and time a full 300-round reload.

flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #6: per-kit noFb defaults OFF and is measured-only. Burst-cast damage is FB-exempt by TIMING (the cast resolves before the FB window opens), not by flag; the skill2 nuke fires on team-hit crossings so it takes FB by timing whenever it lands inside a window.
flags.recipe: Only set noFb if popup values for the 1100% AoE inside a Full Burst measure at the same magnitude as outside it.
